title: AI-Based Synthetic Data in Biomedicine: A Decade of Growth and a Persistent Translation Gap
authors: Asgari N; Pérez IF; Epelde G; Zhang L; Horesh L; Saab CY; Muszkat M; Rosen-Zvi M
one_liner_zh: 该文系统综述了2015-2025年生物医学AI合成数据的增长与转化差距，虽涉及分子和药物应用中的SE(3)等变架构与结构预测模型，但核心是文献计量分析而非蛋白质结构计算建模，对课题仅有间接启发。
abstract: AI-generated synthetic data are increasingly used to address data scarcity, privacy constraints and experimental limitations in biomedicine, but how far these methods have translated into practice remains unclear. We conducted a systematic mapping and bibliometric analysis of 4,143 publications spanning 2015–2025, combining expert annotation with LLM-assisted classification across data modality, medical domain, paper type, deployment status and research stance. Publication volume grew continuously; 77.8% of papers were strongly supportive while critical work remained below 1% . Medical imaging dominated the corpus, consistent with well-characterized transformation-group invariances supporting data augmentation and generative modeling. Highly cited primary research concentrated disproportionately in molecular and pharmaceutical applications, where SE(3)-equivariant architectures and structure-prediction models accelerated generative approaches. Only 27 publications reported operational use; omics and tabular clinical data, lacking well-characterized invariance structures, remained underrepresented. These findings reveal a gap between methodological growth and deployment, motivating investment in evaluation standards, deployment reporting and encoding domain-relevant invariances.
abstract_zh: AI生成的合成数据越来越多地被用于解决生物医学中的数据稀缺、隐私约束和实验局限性问题，但这些方法在实践中的转化程度仍不清楚。我们对2015–2025年间4,143篇出版物进行了系统映射和文献计量分析，结合专家标注与LLM辅助分类，涵盖数据模态、医学领域、论文类型、部署状态和研究立场。出版量持续增长；77.8%的论文持强烈支持态度，而批判性工作占比低于1%。医学影像在文献中占主导地位，这与支持数据增强和生成建模的、特征明确的变换群不变性（transformation-group invariances）相一致。高被引的原始研究不成比例地集中在分子和制药应用中，其中SE(3)-等变架构和结构预测模型加速了生成方法的发展。仅有27篇出版物报告了实际部署使用；组学（omics）和表格型临床数据，由于缺乏特征明确的不变性结构，仍然代表性不足。这些发现揭示了方法学增长与部署之间的差距，促使在评估标准、部署报告和编码领域相关不变性方面进行投资。
